text_block_list.text:
Neither Нарита Таисин nor Winning
Ticket
manage to conquer the Japanese
Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite having her dream crushed,
Winning
Ticket is still looking forward to
the next race,
and Нарита Таисин is left
deeply impressed by
such determination.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин reaffirms her dedication to
keep
pushing on, so she can seize
victory at the final
race of the Triple
Crown tour—the Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
